//rawDir: Where scripts/screenshots.mjs writes its captures; {locale} is replaced per language.
//locales: Each locale needs a config/copy.<locale>.json and a capture folder. `dir` there drives RTL.
//slides: Order is the store order. `raw` is a filename in rawDir. `layout`: standard | full-bleed | angled | zoom. `zoom` needs `focus` (fractions of the raw image: x/y are the centre, scale is the magnification). `device`: iphone | pixel.
//targets: Exact export pixels. App Store Connect requires the "iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display)" slot (iPhone 6.1"/6.3"), which accepts only 1206x2622 or 1179x2556 portrait; the large 6.9"/6.5" slots are optional and scaled from it. So one target, one folder: screenshots/store/iphone-6.3/<locale>/. For Google Play add { "id": "play-phone", "store": "play", "width": 1080, "height": 1920, "scale": 3, "format": "jpeg", "quality": 92 } and a featureGraphic block (1024x500 JPEG, plus featureGraphic copy in every copy file).
//ribbon: The corner ribbon with the copy file's `ribbon` word ("Kostenlos" / "Free"), per target and on the feature graphic: true = every slide, "first" = the first slide only, false or absent = none. The same switch lets a target show the price points of the copy files (`{ "text": "Kein Abo", "price": true }`); without it only the plain points appear. Google Play only. Apple treats "free" on a screenshot as a price reference and rejects the version for it (guideline 2.3.7), so the iPhone target stays false. The price words are only true while the app costs nothing at all: they come off the day a paid Plus is sold. See reference/store-specs.md.

targets.//: Google Play phone screenshots. `device` overrides each slide's frame (no iPhone on Play); `slides` picks and orders the eight Play allows. The first slide says what the app is and carries the promise (no ads, no subscription, data stays on the device), so the ribbon is on it only.

//featureGraphic: Google Play feature graphic, exactly 1024x500 JPEG. Its copy is the featureGraphic block of every copy file.
